question.instructions: Choose the next tactical action in a fictional shooter. Priorities: heal if health is below 35 and a medkit remains; otherwise resupply if ammo is 2 or less and hostiles and ammo crates remain; otherwise attack hostiles. After all hostiles are defeated, collect the reactor core, then extract.

criteria.attack: Move toward and shoot the nearest hostile.
criteria.heal: Move to a medkit and restore health.
criteria.resupply: Move to an ammo crate and refill ammunition.
criteria.extract: Carry the reactor core to the exit.

label_source: Explicit game rule priorities; no model-generated labels

training.selection: Maximum validation accuracy, then minimum validation NLL; no test-based changes

calibration.temperature_grid: 101 log-spaced values from 0.1 to 10; minimum temperature-split NLL
calibration.gate_selection: Lowest entropy-confidence threshold accepting >=20 gate cases with zero observed errors; otherwise 1.01 (escalate all)
calibration.scope: Empirical calibration on 100 cases per stage; no guarantee of test error rate

limitations: Synthetic balanced state classification in one fixed text format
Same handcrafted map; fresh episode seeds are not unseen maps
Model chooses tactics; the shared game motor handles movement and aiming
Reward is the upstream proper scoring rule plus cross-entropy, not reward from live gameplay
No hyperparameter search or test-set feedback during this experiment
